remaining.summary: The production Chrome test used the native file chooser. The native drop file-handle path was covered by automated tests.

resolution.summary: Hosted browser media registration immediately exposes File references using the canonical media transaction. Metadata, thumbnails and local persistence run asynchronously. Supported native drops retain a FileSystemFileHandle, with IndexedDB File fallback and no media-byte upload. Production e0e334a48 passed authenticated release checks. In Chrome production, a 512 MiB synthetic file selected through Import appeared in Assets in 110 ms and was ready for timeline insertion in 123 ms; its thumbnail, asset, and timeline clip survived reload. Automated checks cover capturing dropped handles and restoring linked and copied media.
